_comment: PORT campaign: the BUFFER-CAPACITY CLOSURE of IBM Spyre deeptools' `dsc/` data model, into
crates/compiler/deeptools. The scope is ONE self-contained translation unit,
crustify-capacity/cpp/capacity.cpp, holding 19 function bodies extracted VERBATIM from the
authority tree, each preceded by a banner giving its entry number, level, line count and its
ORIGINAL <file>:<line>. Every span is brace-verified and includes its closing brace.
There is no MLIR, LLVM or dcc header anywhere in this campaign. cpp/prelude.inc carries names
only — and unlike bridges 1 and 2, every type these bodies touch IS declared in a plain
header-only part of the authority tree, so the prelude points at the real headers.
READ crustify-capacity/AGENT-BRIEF.md IN FULL BEFORE EDITING ANYTHING.

_comment_acceptance: ⛔ THE GATE IS NOT AN ANCHOR COUNT. An anchor count is what let '1,076 units ported' mean 238
stubs. A unit is DONE only with all three: (1) zero todo! in its body for the arms this campaign
scopes, (2) a REAL NON-TEST CALLER, named in the report, and (3) execution on a real program.
The build gate is `cargo check -p deeptools` + `cargo test -p deeptools`; never the workspace or
the acceptance build in an agent worktree.
⛔ REPORT PER UNIT, NEVER PER CAMPAIGN. '18/18' is this campaign's scope, which is not the stage
and not the bridge. A campaign cannot audit its own boundary.
